alt: Tesla vehicle interior showing the driver's seat and dashboard with no steering wheel installed — a demonstration of the wheel-free design Musk announced for a Model Y variant
story: At the NY Times DealBook Summit on November 19, 2026, Elon Musk announced Tesla will build a Model Y variant with no steering wheel or pedals — despite Tesla's own robotaxi fleet already using steering-wheel-equipped Model Ys, and Cox Automotive finding only 10% of US consumers prefer fully driverless Level 5 autonomy (down from 17% in 2016); Musk gave no timeline, price, or location.
why_funny: Tesla's solution to low demand for autonomous cars is to remove the steering wheel from the car most people buy for its practicality, then announce it at a conference with zero concrete details about when or how it would ever work.
